_comment: The Intel SYCL runtime MoEArc runs against, pinned by version and SHA-256.
These files are NOT redistributed by MoEArc. packaging/fetch-runtime.py downloads them
from Intel's own published channel on PyPI and verifies each against the digest here.
docs/packaging.md, section 'The licence position', says why.
'files' is an allowlist of basenames, not a glob. intel-sycl-rt alone is 134 MB, most of
it libsycl-jit.so (186 MB unpacked) which nothing here loads. Naming the members keeps
the installed runtime at 73 MB and keeps the set auditable.
The four adapters are listed even though exactly one is selected at run time. A partial
adapter set does not degrade -- it fails, with UR_RESULT_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION, which
reads like a version mismatch and is not one. Measured 2026-09-05.
abi_note: Built against oneAPI DPC++ 2026.1.1; this runtime is 2026.1.2. Verified working across that skew on an Arc B580. The soname set (libsycl.so.9, libur_*.so.0) is what actually has to match.
